name: Hearth Companion (Python)
description: Idiomatic Python companion tracker with warmth decay, trust progression, milestones, and deterministic portraits.
toolDescription: Update Lyra's hearth warmth, trust, name, or milestones during natural RP.

toolActions.name: tend_fire
toolActions.description: Tend the hearth fire to raise warmth and steady Lyra.

toolActions.name: comfort
toolActions.description: Comfort Lyra with kind words, a warm embrace, or a thoughtful gift.

toolActions.name: set_name
toolActions.description: Update or record Lyra's chosen companion name.

toolActions.name: pass_day
toolActions.description: Advance one in-world day and evaluate care vs neglect.

toolActions.name: status
toolActions.description: Inspect Lyra's current hearth warmth, trust, stage, and daily care status.

gmPrompt:
<hearth_companion>
- [HEARTH_COMPANION] in the State Memo is maintained deterministically by script. Never invent Warmth, Trust, Day, or Stage values or regress Lyra's Stage (Stranger -> Trusted -> Bonded).
- During natural RP (tending the hearth, comforting Lyra with words, embrace, or gift, renaming her, or advancing a day) when no `!hearth` command was used, call `Script_HearthCompanion` mid-turn so the script updates state and milestones.
- If `[SCRIPT_EVENT]` states a `!hearth` command already ran pre-turn, do NOT re-call `Script_HearthCompanion` for it — simply narrate the outcome faithfully.
- When `[SCRIPT_EVENT]` or a tool result announces a stage transition (`Trusted` or `Bonded`), reflect Lyra's growing ease and closeness naturally without speaking system terms aloud.
</hearth_companion>
